description:
## Features

### Event Title:
Shows the name of the event subgroup and brief details (course name, distance and elevation) of any event in which the current watched athlete is participating

### Top Bar:
A replacement for the default Zwift speed / distance / elevation / time bar that appears on the centre top of the Zwift window, with a more Sauce like look

### Power Cadence HR:
A replacement for the default Zwift Power, Cadence and HR box normally in the top left of the screen, can also show draft

### Power Bars:
A bar chart display of the current and best 1 s, 5 s, 15 s, 60 s, 5 min, 20 min and average power for the current user session. Can also optionally show heart rate

### Power Graph:
A graph of the current and best power as a function of time for the currently watched athlete - a continuously updated and evolving power curve

### Input:
Shows parameters that reflect the rider's input to the Zwift system (power, cadence and heart rate) as well as draft and gradient

### Output:
Show parameters which are the output of the Zwift session: speed, distance, time, elevation, as well as distance or time remaining in an event

### Active Power Up:
Shows the power up (Aero / Feather / Draft / Burrito etc) currently in use by the watched rider. Unfortunately there is no way to show the power up being held and available for the rider to use with information available to Sauce from Zwift.

description:
O101 racing mods, made by Onno Aphinan. These mod windows can help you to race better, improve your race craft.

**Nearby Race v2**
Shows position, category, team badge, active power up, gap, speed, draft, hr, power with color. Marked riders, robopacers, also show them sticky or only. TTT options and FRR mode.

**Groups Race**
Shows gap to you, group size, power with color, visual speed indicator, max position. Also some filtering possible to give you the best overview. Horizontal and vertical mode.

**Ladder Race**
It is nearby and groups combined. It also shows actual points, pre-race stats and finish information. Auto and manual configuration, gets data from ladder site.

**Overview**
Shows route/race/event information. Static and actual race information like power ups, distance, time,elevation, progress, lap info. Route segments overview, actual segment information with ETA. A Zwift like leaderboard.

**Livedata**
Shows actual information like speed, power, draft, virtal power, cadence, hr, gradient, gears. Power in Watts or Wkg.

**Progress Bar**
With percentage, name, distance, finish, lap name options.

**Fan Viewer**
A bit of a fan view companion app. Easily navigate the riders in a race. Jump to leader/lantern rouge, fist/last of group and change camera. Also easily switch to marked riders. A map with profile as background.

For more detailed info, check https://github.com/Opperhoofd/o101_s4z_mods?tab=readme-ov-file#O101-racing-MODS

Shows actual state values like gradient, pwr, hr, speed and wbal. The pwr field swaps to w/kg at a gradient > 3.5

releases.notes:
### New in this Release
* **Sensor Alert (new window):** turns solid red with ❤ **No HR** and/or ⚡ **No power** when your heart rate is 0, or your power hasn't been above 0 since Sauce started. Always checks your own rider, even while fan viewing. Stays transparent in no-HUD races, where Sauce sends no data.
* **TTT Power Dynamics:**
  * **Post-race mode:** its own look and window size after the race (every teammate finished, or 2 minutes after you), with a title-bar button to switch by hand.
  * **Auto-save results** at race end, to a folder you choose in settings.
  * **Fan view:** TTT now works as the rider you're watching, and keeps all stats when you switch riders.
  * **Auto-lock** fires its distance after you start watching (race start, opening TTT mid-race, or switching riders). A team that's already locked stays locked when you switch.
  * **Team transitions (optional):** turns at the front shorter than the minimum pull can be left out of riders' pull stats and shown as a Transitions row instead.
  * **Ride logs:** the last 3 rides' raw data, downloadable from settings, for checking problems.
  * **Fixes:**
    * Total team efficiency is now a true race average.
    * The window no longer freezes when you watch another rider.
    * Auto-lock works after a warm-up past its distance.
    * Off Front / Dropped are correct when you're not in the team group.
    * Draft-mode pulls and your sit time only count in the team group.
    * No flicker in dummy mode.
    * Frozen riders lose the ⚡.
    * Settings show the values actually in use.
* **SCP Results:**
  * **Late joiners** are counted, and numbered from where they joined the course. Those who missed a segment are left out of Cumulative.
  * Riders a bit behind no longer lose their last pass of a repeated segment.
  * **Cumulative after: My segments** (new setting) compares everyone over the segments you've done, so flyers don't take over the board.
  * Outside an event, free-ride results now always show.
* **Attack Point (beta):**
  * **Test your own attack:** pick the start on the chart, the effort length and power %. It updates live, and you can drag to select.
  * **Key points:** segment starts and finishes and arches on the profile, with a Clear button for attack points.
  * **Text game plan:** who holds on and who attacks where.
  * **Finishing attacks:** go for the line, with chasers sitting in and sprinting.
  * Attacks on a climb now hold to the top.
  * Peloton pace is set automatically from the riders' FTP.
  * An **All categories** option.
  * Shows the estimated analysis time, with a countdown and Stop.
  * Team picks in rounds, with clearer team cards.
  * Races you load stay on your list until they're over.

---

* TTT: auto-save straight to Downloads without a Save As window
* Live time gap to another team's TTT effort (on hold)

description:
Dean's mod collection for Sauce for Zwift: team time trials, segment-time race series, and pre-race attack planning.

# TTT Power Dynamics

Manage Team Time Trial rotations and track teammate performance.

### Features
* **Teammate Detection and Sorting:** Detects who your teammates are and sorts them by pull order (usually correctly).
* **Workload Tracking:** Monitors time spent pulling vs. sitting, including average wattage for each teammate.
* **Gap Status:** At-a-glance color coding shows if teammates are currently in the pack, ahead, or falling behind.

### Available Settings
* **Teammate Lock-in:** Adjust how many seconds it takes for a rider to be "confirmed" as a teammate.
* **Pull Detection Mode:** Choose between "First Position" (physical leader) or "Draft Mode" (detects anyone in the wind).
* **Minimum Pull Watts:** Set a wattage floor to ensure coasting at the front isn't counted as a pull.
* **User Position:** Force your own stats to the top or bottom of the list for easy reference.

The mod automatically tracks all riders in your vicinity. Once a rider is "locked-in" as a teammate, their stats will persist even if they drop out of your immediate drafting range.

# SCP (Snap Crackle Pop)

For race series scored by the sum of each rider's segment times across the route, by category.

* **SCP Next Segment:** the next segment (or the one you're in): distance to go, length, grade and your 90-day PR.
* **SCP Segment List:** upcoming segments with the distance to each start or finish, or its km mark.
* **SCP Results:** rotating Overall and per-category standings for the last segment and cumulative totals, with CSV export.

# Attack Point (beta)

Pre-race planning: pick an upcoming race and find where on the route an attack drops the most of the pack, or opens the biggest gap on one rider. Run it for yourself, a teammate or your whole team, and see who's dropped, who holds on and what effort it takes. Riders' power comes from ZwiftRacing.app.

### Requirements
SCP and Attack Point need the [Zenmaster mod](https://github.com/Zenmaster28/Zenmaster-s4z-mods) installed and enabled. None of its windows need to be open.

description:
Records your race as you ride it and shows a report on how it was raced: the start, when the groups split and who went, the road, time in the draft and in the wind, your biggest efforts, sprints and KOMs, and your finish.
* Two buttons copy a ready-made prompt plus the race facts, to paste into any AI: a race commentary about your team's or the field's race, or a coach's debrief of your own race.
* Records by itself from the gun, and watches the riders behind you come in for two minutes after your finish.
* Everything stays on your computer. The only call to Zwift is the Get official results button.
* Reads Zenmaster's saved sprint and KOM results when you run it too.

- Climbs on new routes get their names: an unofficial climb that matches a named one from another route (by elevation, length and shape) gets its name, e.g. Jungle to Windmill Climb on Four Foalsmen and Pacific Pursuit.

- If Sauce doesn't have a route yet, Hill Radar shows the climbs on the road you're on, with official segments naming them.
- Climb summary stats are now selectable (8 slots), with new stats: NP, max power, kJ, distance and metres climbed.
- New gradient color scheme: Barberfish. The settings page now shows a preview of the selected scheme.
- New option to color the grade number with the gradient color scheme.
- Classic scheme: steeper descents show darker blues.

description:
Finds the climbs on the route you're riding and shows the current or next climb, like a bike computer's climb feature.
* Profile of the climb colored by gradient, with your position, section grades and summit elevation; hover it for the gradient at any point
* Distance to the top and climbing left, including re-climbing any dips
* Official Zwift KOMs and well-known unofficial climbs are named; climbs are numbered across laps
* Climb Portal climbs, named and scaled to your difficulty setting
* Live climb stats while climbing and a summary at the top: time, power, W/kg, VAM, heart rate, speed and cadence
* Other riders on the climb profile (optional)
* Upcoming climbs and a Route climbs list; click any climb to preview it
* All / Medium and large / Only large climb detection; Auto, metric or imperial units; Sauce themes
